message: 世界

name: Paqy
message: 「What're you planning to do at the wharf on a day off?」

name: Synn
message: 「Street performers come by on weekends, so I figured I'd watch them for inspiration for the Holy Night Festival.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Sure, it'd liven up the event, but... what's that gotta do with Christmas?」

name: Synn
message: 「C-Crap!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, we're already here. Let's stroll around.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Zzz... zzz...」

name: Paqy
message: 「...I'm hearin' some mighty familiar snores.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, and ones we hear in the Student Council room a lot, too.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Good day to you.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Zzz... Jeeves, zzz... zzz~~」

name: Riesling
message: 「When it comes to providing a lap pillow for the young lady's afternoon nap, please leave it to me, her butler, Riesling Tooyama.」
Riesling-san sat on a bench right beside us while Lolotte slept peacefully with an innocent look. It seemed Riesling-san had masked his presence until we heard her breathing.

name: Lolotte
message: 「I... I can't eat another bite, zzz...」
You look even more comfortable than when you doze off in the Student Council room, Lolotte.

name: Riesling
message: 「Why the complete silence, Master Synn?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh!? N-No, I just thought it'd be rude to interrupt Lolotte's nap.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Staring enchanted at an angel's sleeping face and still keeping up a plausible front--classic Master Synn.」

name: Synn
message: 「Shh, shhhh!!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Rest assured, the sound of the waves has the same effect as a lullaby. Besides, the young lady is resting after a meal. It takes quite a lot to wake her.」

name: Synn
message: 「Did you two eat lunch here, by any chance? Lolotte is always bragging about how delicious your home cooking is, Riesling.」

name: Riesling
message: 「I am humbled.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hahaha, knowing Lolotte, I bet she even went 'Here, say ahh' to you, Riesling.」

name: Riesling
message: 「It is school lunch」
...I-Is that a joke to get back at me?

name: Lolotte
message: 「Zzz, zzz... Gramps, the horizon is straight...」

name: Riesling
message: 「Yes, my lady, even this humble Riesling Tooyama can see it clearly」

name: Synn
message: 「Did you come here to look at the ocean?」

name: Riesling
message: 「My lady expressed a desire to view the sea and witness autumn」

name: Riesling
message: 「I myself recommended the autumn leaves at Asukai Shrine, however...」

name: Synn
message: 「I see... Then Lolotte's officially become a Ryuusei kid」

name: Riesling
message: 「Please explain in detail. My own sensibilities fail to comprehend」

name: Synn
message: 「I-It's not really big enough to need an explanation, though...」

name: Synn
message: 「Day and night in this town come rushing up from the direction of the sea」

name: Riesling
message: 「I understand」

name: Riesling
message: 「Both light and wind first alight upon the ocean, taking in the scent of the tide before reaching Ryuusei Town at the foot of the mountains」

name: Synn
message: 「The seasons are the exact same way」

name: Synn
message: 「Once the long rains clear up and the smell of the ocean starts feeling distant even in town, the sky turns a really pretty light blue」

name: Synn
message: 「When you look out at the horizon from the Tsukinoo Park jetty then, and you can trace a single straight line with your eyes from end to end, that's autumn」

name: Riesling
message: 「Hehe...」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sorry, I sound like some avant-garde poet--pretty ridiculous, right?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Not at all. My lady said the very same thing」

name: Riesling
message: 「This world is sustained by the existence of boundaries」

name: Riesling
message: 「Without the horizon, there is neither sea nor sky. Without the coastline, there is no Ryuusei Town」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What a weird way of thinking...」

name: Riesling
message: 「No, those are not my words, but a Zen riddle from the librarian」

name: Riesling
message: 「However, what that librarian excels at is calculating, analyzing, and deriving theorems from things that already exist」

name: Riesling
message: 「I cannot come up with new ideas the way my lady does」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Zzz, zzz... If there's nothing at all, it'll end up just like Heaven, you know... zzz, zzz--」

name: Synn
message: 「Uh... w-wings came out」

name: Riesling
message: 「Master Synn and I heard nothing and saw nothing」

name: Synn
message: 「Agreed」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Zzz, zzz, zzz--」

name: Riesling
message: 「Autumn is short, and winter's arrival is right around the corner... This will likely be the last time my lady naps outdoors this year」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes, once the sea calms down, it'll get cold all at once」

name: Riesling
message: 「I appreciate your advice. Let us return to the mansion before that happens」
As she spoke, Riesling lowered her gaze to Lolotte and gently combed her fingers through her hair.
Even without me saying anything, she must know the coastal weather inside and out.
I give a polite nod and head toward the plaza where a street performer is balancing on a ball.
